verdict.rationale: Insomnia lets users choose the storage location (Local Vault, Git Sync to their own repo, or Cloud Sync) and states that sync servers cannot read project data, giving some control over where data lives, but there is no evidence of actual geographic region/residency selection for cloud-hosted data. missing for 10: explicit region/data-residency selection options for Cloud Sync, enterprise data-center location controls, independent verification of storage location claims.
